Ganesh ji ne mushak ko vash men kiya | Ganesh Ji Ne Mooshak Ko Vash Mein Kiya | Shiv Mahapuran Episode 40 Scene 1 | T-Series Bhakti Sagar
Om nam shivay gulshan ji ne shiv mahapuran dharavahik ka nirman shiv bhakti ki bhavna ke sath kiya tha, shiv mahapuran ke nirman men unka ek hi uddeshy tha ki shiv bhakti ki bhavna pure sansar men prakashit ho | ham shiv mahapuran dharavahik se kuchh prasangon ko prastut karne ja rahe hain jismen aapko shiv ji juri anekon kathaon ka samagam milega aasha hai hamara ye prayas aap sabhi ko pasand aaega | jay shiv shankar jay bholenath
